newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tamil Tiger rebels kill 100 soldiers in Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Tamil Tiger rebels kill 100 soldiers in Sri Lanka.

text.p: Tamil Tiger guerrillas killed at least 100 Sri Lankan soldiers in a massive counter-attack near the northern rebel stronghold of Kilinochchi on Thursday, military officials said.

In a pre-dawn attack on advancing government troops, members of the separatist Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) hit the rear of an army column with mortars, one military officer said asking not to be identified.

"We lost at least 100 soldiers in a massive terrorist counter-attack early this morning." He said 45 of the dead and 70 wounded had been flown to Colombo by Thursday evening, No other details were given.

Sri Lankan forces earlier on Thursday reported slow progress in a pincer move by two columns of troops in their push from the road junction town of Paranthan, six km (four miles) north of Kilinochchi. The two flanks are heading in different directions to surround the rebel base.

Thursday's pre-dawn attack was the first reported major assault by the rebels since government troops launched a fresh offensive against the rebels' Kilinochchi stronghold last Sunday after a lull in the conflict of more than a month.
